identity.resolvedIdentity: The named medieval stone church at Grønnsundveien 1, often called Østfolddomen and dedicated to St. Olav, distinct from the broader Eidsberg locality and the surrounding churchyard.
identity.identityProblem: The record names one church building with a long and layered construction history. The gameplay point should follow the building without treating the churchyard or historical site as one exact geometry or implying that every visible part dates from one year.
identity.splitReason: The church building and immediate church site form one coherent destination. The churchyard remains associated context rather than a separate canonical place in this record.

evidence.finding: The entity links OSM way 285802498, Kulturminne ID 84070, SSR 854723 and Church of Norway building ID 824. Its coordinate is approximately 1.7 metres from the applied point.

evidence.finding: The official church page gives Grønnsundveien 1 as the address, describes a Gothic church built 1250–1260, identifies the St. Olav dedication and documents extensive rebuilding in 1880–1881.
evidence.reason: Confirms current identity, address and source-supported chronology.

evidence.finding: The scholarly church survey documents medieval masonry, repairs, additions and later alterations and supports treating the building as a layered historical structure.
evidence.reason: Prevents an oversimplified one-date interpretation of the visible church.
